produced.format: 44.1 kHz, 16-bit stereo WAV, 15.000 s each (local time 0 = version start; place v1 at global 3.0, v2 at 19.0, v3 at 35.0, D=v1 at 51.0), peak <= -1 dBFS

v1.gain: rms per layer, -3 dB in shot B

v2.gain: rms per layer, -3 dB in shot B

v3.gain: rms per layer, -3 dB in shot B

test_notes: Onsets: energy-flux detection on the 1.5-16 kHz band of the finished stem in 5.7-6.6 s; tolerance 1 frame = 41.7 ms; E4 is also checked against frame 152 (6.333 s).

Interval: 'interval_semitones_estimated' = log-frequency spectral shift between the two strike signals; 'interval_semitones_matched_filter_stem' = resampling ratio (in semitones, 0.1 st steps) that best maps the stem's strike-1 window onto its strike-2 window, with its normalised correlation. The log-spectrum-minus-bed figure is unreliable for very short broadband strikes and is kept only for the record.
centroid_ratio: spectral centroid of strike 2 / strike 1 (target 1.1892 for +3 st).

repair_r2_editor.straight_talk_1992: dropped from the 2009 bed (no independent rights record found on archive.org or loc.gov); build_sound.py now uses Formations (1936) for the 2009 traffic wash; stems rebuilt
repair_r2_editor.rights_verified: Third Avenue El (ThirdAve1950), Formations (Formatio1936), Arteries of New York City (Arteries1941), Dating: Do's and Don'ts (DatingDo1949): Prelinger Archives items on archive.org, metadata licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/licenses/publicdomain/ (read via archive.org/metadata API)
repair_r2_editor.pitch_method: strike 2 is strike 1 resampled by exactly 2**(3/12)=1.1892, which shifts every partial by +3.00 st. The matched-filter estimate in the finished stem reads 3.0 st for all eras. A single spectral-peak pick on the stem (467 to 599 Hz for 1959) is unreliable for a broadband knock: the bed and the resampled body resonance change which partial is the maximum. It is not the measure used.
repair_r2_editor.still_fallback: 2009 hollow knock stays handmade (1959 strike + panel resonance): Commons upload host still returned HTTP 429 for the CC BY-SA hollow-door knock
